email.subject: Quick note on Honey Works' site
email.body:
Hi Grace,

I took a look at Honey Works Hair Studio's website. Two things are likely costing you bookings: it's not mobile-friendly, so most clients searching on their phones get a broken layout and leave, and there's no click-to-call button, so people have to copy your number instead of just tapping to book. Combined with no reviews showing and a footer with last year's hours, it's probably costing you new client calls every week.

Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd fix. No pressure either way.

Alex
Northlight Web
